evidence_spans.text: Perturb-seq uses a CRISPR lentiviral vector delivering sgRNA and an expressed GBC, with scRNA-seq readout to link each cell's transcriptional profile to its perturbation(s).

MIMOSCA fits a regularized linear model with elastic net, accounting for technical covariates (number of transcripts, detection probability) and biological covariates (cell state, subtype), and can include interaction terms.

In BMDCs, modules M2 (Cebpb, Rela, JunB) and M4 (Spi1, Irf4, Nfkb1, Runx1) have opposing effects on BMDC differentiation states: M2 promotes LPS-responsive programs (P4, P5) while M4 promotes a less differentiated state (P2).
Genetic interactions in BMDCs: pairs involving Nfkb1 show buffering interactions; many pairs with Runx1, Irf1, Irf2, Irf4 are additive; interactions are associated with TF co-binding.
In K562 cells, Perturb-seq of cell-cycle regulators reveals distinct transcriptional profiles even when fitness effects are similar, indicating different underlying mechanisms.

Effect of the number of cells (y axis) and transcripts (x axis) on recovery as measured by correlation (color bar) with either the per gene (A) or cell-state signature (B) effects observed in the full data for BMDCs at 3 hr. The number of cells per perturbation (1.0) is a mean of 300 and a median of 155 and the number of transcripts per cell (1.0) is a median of 5,074.
The TF modules regulate programs consistent with known functions.
Fitting a linear model without cell-state covariates, the TFs partition into two modules (Figure 6A)... The model correctly predicts individual TF functions.

cells perturbed for M2 TFs (Cebpb, Rela, JunB) are enriched in clusters matching P2 and depleted in clusters matching P5, whereas those perturbed for M4 TFs (Spi1, Irf4, Nfkb1, Runx1) have the opposite effect

Most TF pairs involving one of Runx1, Irf1, Irf2, or Irf4 had mostly additive effects, whereas pairs with combinations of Stat1, Stat2, Stat3, Rela, Nfkb1, and Spi1 were enriched for interactions. Only those involving Nfkb1 (Stat1-Nfkb1, Stat3-Nfkb1, Rela-Nfkb1, Spi1-Nfkb1) were enriched for buffering interactions.
Perturbations of Cell-Cycle Regulators Reveal Distinct Profiles Associated with Similar Fitness Effects and Mitotic Arrest

To quantify the significance of these fold changes we developed a Bayesian probabilistic model... compute a binomial p value, correct for multiple hypotheses via Bonferroni correction, and report the significant findings.

The model correctly predicts individual TF functions. For example, GABPA perturbation represses mitochondrial functions... YY1 perturbation is correctly predicted to represses oxidative phosphorylation...

At its current scale, Perturb-seq can be readily applied for targeted screens of a subset of genes of interest and their interactions... Our analysis suggests that a broad survey of transcriptional phenotypes across thousands of perturbations can be performed with a few tens of cells per perturbation... MIMOSCA is designed foreseeing screens with millions of cells...

We devised a computational framework (MIMOSCA) based on a regularized linear model, to estimate the impact of perturbations on gene expression... We fit the coefficient matrix with elastic net regularization... We also consider biological covariates of distinct cell subtypes or states... We can incorporate nonlinear interactions in our framework, by adding interaction terms between covariates.
A technology combining single-cell RNA sequencing with CRISPR-based perturbations termed Perturb-seq makes analyzing complex phenotypes at a large scale possible
Based on the estimated fit, over 66% of cells are affected by their delivered perturbation, on average.

The targets our model predicted for most TFs are strongly supported by chromatin immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) data... The model also correctly predicted the targets and logic of repressors... both sets are enriched for ChIP targets of both Nfkb1 and Rela... but only the set with the dominant interaction is enriched for co-binding.

M2 and M4—with their distinct pioneer factors Cebpb and Spi1, respectively—have mutually opposing effects: M2 may promote differentiation, leading to LPS-responsive programs (P4 and P5), whereas M4 promotes a mutually exclusive state that is either less differentiated or less productive ex vivo (P2).

We had a 94% (92%–96%) detection probability with an initial MOI of 0.63 in the K562 TF pool, a 98% probability with an MOI of 0.35 in the cell-cycle pool, and a 60% detection probability with an MOI of 1.4 in BMDCs at 3 hr.
The model predicts each TF's effect on transcriptional programs, including positive and negative regulation of five programs (P1–P5).

limitations.statement: Current Perturb-seq scale is suitable for targeted screens; genome-wide or combinatorial screens require increased cell throughput and computational scaling.
Probability of detecting all perturbations and their effects scales exponentially with the order of perturbations.
Linear model may not capture all nonlinearities; interaction terms are limited to those included.
On-target reduction detection is affected by target expression level in WT cells, capture efficiency, and incomplete nonsense-mediated decay.
GBC detection probability is lower in BMDCs (60%) due to lower cell complexity; increases to 70% after filtering low-complexity cells.

methods.description: A method combining pooled CRISPR screen with single-cell RNA-seq readout. Lentiviral vector delivers sgRNA and an expressed GBC. Cells are transduced, selected (FACS or antibiotics), grown/differentiated/stimulated, then scRNA-seq performed in a single pool. GBCs are enriched via PCR after whole transcriptome amplification. MOI can be varied for single or combinatorial perturbations.

methods.description: A regularized linear model (elastic net) predicting each gene's expression as a function of guide effects, technical covariates (number of transcripts, detection probability), and biological covariates (cell state, subtype). Permutation-based significance testing. Iterative re-assignment of perturbation probability to cells. Can incorporate interaction terms for genetic interactions or cell-state-specific effects.

methods.description: Cell states defined from unperturbed cells by selecting variable genes via Loess regression on coefficient of variation vs. mean expression, normalizing to 10,000 transcripts, log2 transformation, Z-transformation, randomized PCA retaining top ~10 components, clustering with Infomap, and iterative merging until no pairwise clusters have <100 differentially expressed genes (Welch's t test, Benjamini-Hochberg FDR).
